DECISION (operator-approved, 2026-08-30): **Option A — detect-and-signal only.**

Fix scope for THIS ticket is narrowed to closing the SILENT-failure defect, NOT full auto-apply:
- Enumerate `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` (and any other edge input) in an autodeploy detect manifest so a merged edge change is DETECTED.
- On a detected edge delta, raise the `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` detect-and-signal treatment that `CONFIG_PATHS` already gets (bug 1630 precedent) — an operator then applies it. Do NOT implement unattended render/`nginx -t`/reload here.
- Blast radius: never touch the `gerrit` container; this change adds a manifest entry + a signal path + tests only. No box mutation.

Rationale + standing intent: ADR 0079 (story 8903) deliberately scoped v1 auto-apply to the review-bot container and made Gerrit config DETECT-ONLY, explicitly deferring "config auto-apply" to v2 because auto-applying config to a box hosting a live fail-closed submit gate is high-risk. The nginx edge falls in that same deferred bucket; the genuine defect here is that it fell through BOTH categories and gets no signal at all. Option A restores it to parity with CONFIG_PATHS without crossing the deferred v1->v2 boundary. OSS precedent: Argo CD keeps drift DETECTION always-on but auto-sync opt-in; Terraform separates plan from apply.

The full unattended auto-apply (Option B) is captured as idea epic **sprucing-wise-dikkops (6d60-2d0c-6ff7-444b)** — needs its own design + ADR before promotion.

AC update for Option A: AC2 collapses to the "signalled via AUTODEPLOY_ERROR" branch (drop the "or applied" alternative). AC "malformed conf fails nginx -t and is rolled back" moves to the Option B epic. The "a61d unblocked / verified live at the edge" AC is satisfied by a SEPARATE operator deploy after this lands (a shared-box mutation requiring approval), not by this change.

Dispatching a background /rebar-debug agent to implement under this narrowed scope.

## RCA + fix (rebar-debug protocol, Option A)

**Problem.** Autodeploy deploys containers and swaps the `/mcp/` upstream include, but the nginx edge source of truth `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` is absent from every path manifest in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, so a merged edge change is never detected and — unlike a Gerrit config change (`AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=config_manual`) — emits NO signal. It fails silently.

**Proven root cause (mechanism).** `changed() { changed_range "$DEPLOYED" "$TARGET" "$1"; }` is only ever called with the six existing manifests (BOT/SECRETS/MCP/CONFIG/OBS/CERTBOT); none contains `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template`. With no `if changed "<edge>"` block, an edge-only delta reaches the end of the tick with no `err`/`marker` call. Confirmed at runtime, not statically: driving the REAL `autodeploy.sh` (git stub → only `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` changed, `main` advanced d…d → e…e) prints `main advanced …; computing component deltas` and `deploy complete` on stdout and emits **nothing** on stderr — no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`. This is a `dynamic` hypothesis (the signal never fires) confirmed by observing the run, discriminating it from "a delta was computed but a different signal fired".

**Defect origin (`caused_by`) — scope-of-work omission, story 8903.** The path-manifest + `changed`-detection deploy model was introduced by commits `479c3a57b4c0` and `463739cdb481`, both carrying `rebar-ticket: 8903-efb2-b73f-4e22` (Epic 88ab / story `gall-plume-adder`, autodeploy v1). ADR 0079 scoped v1 apply to the review-bot container and made Gerrit config detect-only, but the plan never enumerated the nginx edge in **either** the apply or the detect-only category. This is an omission / incomplete-implementation, not a regression: the edge was never detected, so there is no "later change broke it" commit — `git blame` on the manifest region names the CONFIG/OBS/CERTBOT authors, none of whom owned the edge. Attribution is **by scope-of-work** to 8903 (the story whose ACs the missing case falls under), not by introducing commit. Recorded via `--caused-by=8903-efb2-b73f-4e22`, close_class `plan_defect`. Date test: the omission predates any behavior transition (it never worked), consistent with an omission rather than a regression.

**Test (RED→GREEN, held out, mutation-checked).** New `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_nginx_edge.py` (mirrors `test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py`): drives the real `autodeploy.sh` where only `rebar.conf.template` changed and asserts `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` with `reason=nginx_edge_manual` and a `detail` naming `rebar.conf.template`. Verified legitimately RED first (asserted `None` — no marker — with the fix absent). The fix was written by a subagent that never saw the test; GREEN on restore. Mutation check (in a macOS `sandbox-exec` jail): re-seeding the root cause (`if changed "$EDGE_PATHS"` → `if false`) returns the test to RED, proving teeth. It asserts observable stderr output, not internal names, so it is not a change-detector.

**Fix.** `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`: (1) new `EDGE_PATHS='infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template'` manifest with a comment explaining the DETECT-ONLY v1 boundary and the v2 deferral (epic 6d60); (2) a detect-only block mirroring `CONFIG_PATHS` exactly — `if changed "$EDGE_PATHS"; then err nginx_edge_manual "…rebar.conf.template needs a MANUAL operator render + nginx reload…"; log …; fi`. `observability.sh:232` already counts every `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {` into the `deploy_errors` CloudWatch metric regardless of `reason`, so the miss becomes visible via the same always-on on-box journald path — no observability change, no CI-provider dependency (portable). No render / `nginx -t` / reload / rollback (deferred to epic 6d60).

**Scope & safety.** Caller-dependency sweep: `EDGE_PATHS`/`nginx_edge_manual` are new symbols with no other callers; the block reuses existing `err`/`changed`/`marker` — only-incidental usage, clears the gate. Restoration not creation (restores parity with `CONFIG_PATHS`; legitimacy = incomplete-implementation, cited to 8903/ADR 0079 — completing approved work). No new dependency. No existing test weakened (new test only). Never touches the `gerrit` container; mutates no AWS box.

**Siblings (Step 7).** Both axes converge on one confirmed sibling class: the host-nginx *includes* the edge template glob-includes are materialized by `compose-up.sh` (`materialize-opcert-guard.sh`, `materialize-mcp-upstream.sh`, the `mcp-upstream.conf` seed) and `compose-up.sh` itself — absent from every manifest and never re-run by the autodeploy loop (autodeploy re-runs only `install-observability.sh`/`install-certbot-timer.sh`/`fetch-secrets.sh`). Same silent-drift class, NOT covered by epic 6d60. Filed as **satiated-activated-aardwolf (5524-e353-2e2d-4dbe)**, linked `discovered_from` this bug. Not fixed here: it touches `nginx -s reload` apply semantics (the deferred v1→v2 boundary) and a distinct surface, outside the operator-approved Option A scope.

**Residual risk.** (1) `mcp-upstream.conf` seed / materialize-script drift → ticketed (5524). (2) This change only makes the miss *visible*; a human still renders+reloads the edge (unattended auto-apply is epic 6d60, accepted per Option A). (3) The `deployed-sha`/`origin/main` divergence noted in the report is a separate cadence/backoff observation, not addressed here (accepted; out of this bug's mechanism).

**Replication.** The report's scenario (main advances with only the edge changed) driven through the real `autodeploy.sh` entry point now emits the `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` signal instead of silently no-op'ing. Full scripts suite: 1307 passed, 3 skipped, no regressions.

**Landing.** Change goes through Gerrit (`git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main`); submittable only at `LLM-Review +1` AND `Verified +1`. The "verified live at the edge" / a61d-unblocked AC is a SEPARATE operator deploy after this lands (a shared-box mutation), not performed by this change. `caused_by`/close will be recorded on the close after the change is `Verified +1`.

## Summary

Autodeploy deploys container components but **never** re-renders `/etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf`. The edge is not "skipped because a delta was missed" — its source template is absent from **every** component path manifest in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, so a delta can never be detected. Any merged change to the nginx edge stays permanently un-live until a human applies it by hand, **and — unlike a Gerrit config change — it emits NO signal, so the miss is silent.**

## Evidence (live box i-00880b2c7f13527c5)

The complete manifest set in `/opt/rebar/infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` (BOT_PATHS, SECRETS_PATHS, MCP_PATHS, CONFIG_PATHS, OBS_PATHS, CERTBOT_PATHS) contains no reference to `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` — the edge source of truth (the only file in `infra/` containing `proxy_redirect`). There is no `NGINX_PATHS`/`EDGE_PATHS`. The only nginx write autodeploy performs is the MCP blue-green pointer swap against a *separate* materialized include (`mcp-upstream.conf`); it never regenerates `rebar.conf`.

Confirming state: `/etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf` mtime=2026-08-27 22:05:26 (predates the 2026-08-28 23:21 deploy); `proxy_redirect` count = 7 (the pre-`a61d` shape). So change `25fd2cf6dd75` (a61d) is merged but not live, and cannot become live by itself.

Story `gall-plume-adder` (8903) scoped v1 auto-apply to the review-bot container only, with Gerrit config as detect-only (`CONFIG_PATHS`). The nginx edge was enumerated in **neither** category, so it does not even get the `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` detect-and-signal treatment `CONFIG_PATHS` receives — it fails **silently**.

## DECISION (operator-approved, 2026-08-30): Option A — detect-and-signal only

This ticket is narrowed to closing the SILENT-failure defect, NOT full auto-apply. ADR 0079 (story 8903) deliberately scoped v1 auto-apply to the review-bot container and made Gerrit config DETECT-ONLY, explicitly deferring "config auto-apply" to v2. The nginx edge falls in that same deferred bucket; the genuine defect is that it fell through BOTH categories and gets no signal at all. Option A restores it to parity with `CONFIG_PATHS` without crossing the deferred v1→v2 boundary. Full unattended auto-apply (Option B) is captured as idea epic **sprucing-wise-dikkops (6d60-2d0c-6ff7-444b)**.

## Fix plan (Option A)

1. Add a new detect manifest `EDGE_PATHS='infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template'` in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, declared alongside `CONFIG_PATHS`, with a comment explaining it is DETECT-ONLY (v1 boundary) and why applying the edge (host `nginx -t` + reload) is deferred to v2 / epic 6d60.
2. Add a detect-only block that mirrors the existing `CONFIG_PATHS` block exactly: `if changed "$EDGE_PATHS"; then err <edge-reason> "<operator-actionable detail naming rebar.conf.template>"; log ...; fi`. `err` → `marker AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`, which `observability.sh` (line 232) already counts into the `deploy_errors` metric regardless of `reason`, so no observability change is needed — the miss becomes visible via the same always-on on-box journald→CloudWatch path (no CI-provider dependency; portable).
3. No render / `nginx -t` / `nginx -s reload` / rollback here — deferred to epic 6d60.

Blast radius: one manifest variable + one detect/signal block + tests. Never touches the `gerrit` container; mutates no AWS box (the change deploys itself later via autodeploy; a61d's live validation is a separate operator step).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC1 — `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` is enumerated in a new autodeploy detect manifest (`EDGE_PATHS`), so a merged change to it is detected over `deployed..target`.
- [x] AC2 — On a detected edge delta, autodeploy raises the `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` detect-and-signal treatment exactly as `CONFIG_PATHS` does (a `marker AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` with an edge-specific `reason` and an operator-actionable `detail` naming `rebar.conf.template`) — never silently ignored. (Collapsed to the "signalled via AUTODEPLOY_ERROR" branch; the "or applied (render→nginx -t→reload)" alternative is dropped and moved to epic 6d60.)
- [x] AC3 — Detect+signal never restarts or otherwise touches the `gerrit` container and mutates no AWS box; blast radius is the manifest entry + signal path + tests.
- [x] AC4 — Regression coverage: a script-level test drives `autodeploy.sh` where ONLY `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` changed and asserts the `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` edge signal (mirroring `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py`).

### Moved to epic sprucing-wise-dikkops (6d60) — OUT OF SCOPE here

- (Tracked in epic **sprucing-wise-dikkops** `6d60-2d0c-6ff7-444b`; not an AC of this ticket.) Full auto-apply: render template → `nginx -t` → atomic `nginx -s reload`, with rollback to the prior conf on `nginx -t` failure; `deployed-sha` not advanced on a malformed conf.

### Satisfied by a SEPARATE operator deploy AFTER this lands — NOT by this change

- (Separate operator deploy AFTER this lands; not an AC of this change.) Proven live: a merged edge change reaches `/etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf` (mtime advance + new directive set), and `enchanting-phantastic-weevil` (a61d) `25fd2cf6dd75` is verified live at the edge. This is a shared-box mutation requiring operator approval; it is not performed by this change.
